text_block_list.text: (WOOAAAH!!)

text_block_list.name: Flash's Mother
text_block_list.text:
"‘...!! What incredible enthusiasm.
So this is a Japanese GⅠ race...’"

text_block_list.name: Flash's Father
text_block_list.text:
"It seems to be a race rich in tradition.
And our Schatzi..."

text_block_list.name: Flash's Mother
text_block_list.text:
...
Do your best, Flash...!

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text: —It seems my parents have arrived safely at the venue.

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
Everything is proceeding smoothly, and I'm not in a bad mood at all.
Things are progressing as scheduled, and all that's left is...
choice_data_list: All that's left now is to prove you're right.
All that's left now is to prove you're right.

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text: My righteousness...

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
...Trainer.
I have a favor to ask.

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
Please watch over the race today
together with my parents.

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text: When this is over, I promise... I will find the three of them.
(Waaaaah...)

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text: ...Phew.

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text: (Amidst this massive roar of cheers, my mother and father are watching.)

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
(I wanted to become someone worthy of the two people I respect, someone to be proud of.
That's why I decided to see this race through to the very end.)

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
(I thought that was "righteousness."
However, that... began to change shape.)

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text: (Meeting Trainer made me realize my own immaturity... and gave me a fresh perspective.)

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
(My chest burned hot in the Derby.
Tenacity became the "justification" to seize victory.)

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
(The rivals in the "Golden Age" were formidable,
making me want to abandon the schedule.
And yet—)

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
(There were people who taught me
that I wasn't just inexperienced.)

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text: (Right now, the "righteousness" I have grasped is—)

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text: —It is the very embodiment of who I am right now.

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
(From that day I said goodbye to my parents
and set off for Japan—
I have changed.)

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
I will prove that I have grown.
To my father, to my mother... and to you.

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
Auf geht's!
—With pride on the line, I accept the challenge!
